---
title: "Case study: ants along Mt Wilhelm, from sites to maps"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dev.args = list(bg = "white"),
  collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", out.width = "100%",
  dpi = 150, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5
)
```

`png_ants` (in tidydiversity) records ground-foraging ants at nutrient
baits at elevations from 200 to 2200 m on Mt Wilhelm, Papua New Guinea, in
the dry and the wet season (Moses et al. 2023,
[doi:10.5281/zenodo.8191946](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8191946)).
tidydiversity estimates diversity; tidymapr maps it.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidymapr)
library(tidydiversity)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Study sites

The example table records elevation but not GPS, so `geo_example_sites()`
supplies illustrative WGS84 positions. Replace them with your own
coordinates before publication.

```{r sites, fig.height = 5, fig.alt = "Study sites along Mt Wilhelm coloured by elevation band"}
sites <- geo_example_sites("wilhelm") |>
  filter(elevation <= 2200)
plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site, basemap = "coast") +
  labs(title = "Ant sampling sites on Mt Wilhelm")
```

## Diversity on a map

```{r map, fig.height = 5, fig.alt = "Observed ant richness on a map, one panel per season"}
est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 0, nboot = 0, .by = season) |>
  left_join(sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
plot_geo(filter(est, season == "wet"), estimate, lon, lat, label = site, basemap = "coast") +
  labs(title = "Observed richness, wet season", colour = "Species")
```

## Distance decay

`geo_decay()` computes pairwise dissimilarity with
`tidydiversity::beta_pair()` and joins geographic or elevational distance.

```{r decay, fig.alt = "Ant dissimilarity against geographic distance by season"}
com <- left_join(png_ants, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
decay <- geo_decay(com, lon, lat, .by = season, method = "haversine")
autoplot(decay)
beta_decay_model(decay)
```

## Spatial autocorrelation

```{r moran}
wet <- filter(est, season == "wet")
geo_moran(wet, estimate, lon, lat, nperm = 199, seed = 1)
```

## Save the figure

`geo_save()` writes maps at journal sizes:

```r
p <- plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site)
geo_save(p, "fig1-sites.pdf", width = 170, height = 120, units = "mm")
```
